items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is active. Earlier Rapoport: likely to play after foot injury week (LP-DNP-LP); not as serious as prior rib.
items.why: Expected/likely per Rap/ETR; Schefter confirms active. Levitan bigger dock for foot/ribs.
items.implication: Playable but docked; monitor early snaps vs SEA.
items.opportunity: Primary WR role targets if full go, caution volume.
items.conflict: Levitan bigger projection dock vs full active

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans officially active after optimistic push with rib injury; practiced late week, team optimistic despite 'fractured ribs suck' note.
items.why: Rap confirms active; ETR GTD/optimistic, Levitan bigger ribs dock.
items.implication: Startable but volume risk from ribs pain.
items.opportunity: Red-zone/target share if durable through game.
items.conflict: Bigger Levitan dock vs active confirmation

items.text: Lamar Jackson is questionable to return vs. the Titans today due to an ankle injury; Huntley in for third quarter.
items.implication: Ravens offense downgrade if out; monitor return.
items.opportunity: If out long, checkdown/run game shifts.

items.text: WR Ja’Marr Chase is out due to a concussion after evaluation for possible concussion mid-game vs Jaguars.
items.why: Concussion protocol after hit; Schefter/Rap confirm.
items.implication: Bengals WR targets funnel elsewhere rest of game/possibly next.

items.text: Saquon Barkley has been downgraded to out after hamstring injury; initially Q to return after pulling up early vs Rams.
items.why: Hamstring strain mid-game; Rap/Schefter align. Eagles already thin.
items.implication: Remaining carries to backups; major Eagles offense hit with OL/WR/TE issues.

items.text: Commanders star WR Terry McLaurin is officially out for today’s game in London against the Colts after late-week hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring surfaced late; team chose caution. ETR listed not expected.
items.implication: Commanders pass game thinned further with Daniels already out; targets redistribute.

items.text: Sources: Rams do not intend to limit Puka Nacua’s workload today vs. the Eagles after return from groin/hip.
items.why: Schefter sources confirm full workload intent; ETR/Levitan small dock only.
items.implication: Full-usage WR1 upgrade in return spot vs depleted Eagles secondary/OL.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore (shoulder) has been downgraded to doubtful after earlier questionable to return.
items.implication: Unlikely return; Bills WR depth tested.
items.opportunity: Target bump for other Bills pass-catchers.

items.text: Not one but two Bhayshul Tuten touchdowns have been called back due to penalty.
items.why: Live game: two TDs nullified by flags shows red-zone/goal-line usage.
items.implication: Confirms goal-line role/opportunity despite unlucky flags.
items.opportunity: Clear goal-line/red-zone carries; handcuff/backup upside if primary limited.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers, on injury report for knee, now has illness too vs Chiefs; Raiders fully expecting him to play.
items.why: Team fully expecting despite dual issues.
items.implication: TE1 remains viable if plays through.
items.opportunity: Standard high-volume TE role if active.

items.text: Eagles OT Lane Johnson inactive today due to personal reasons (earlier Q); rookie Markel Bell starts RT. Eagles 18-29 without him.
items.why: Personal reasons; Rap confirms inactive. Compounds Eagles absences (Smith, Goedert, Baun, later Barkley).
items.implication: Eagles OL/pass pro/run game further depleted vs Rams.
items.opportunity: Rams pass rush upside; Eagles skill reduced efficiency.

items.text: Commanders ruled out QB Marcus Mariota for today’s game vs Colts (knee); aggravated MCL, tests upcoming, miss some time. Hope Daniels back next week.
items.why: Knee/MCL aggravation in-game then downgraded; Rap aligns.
items.implication: Rookie QB in; Commanders offense major downgrade with McLaurin also out.

items.text: Baker Mayfield dealing with dislocated thumb expected to sideline 3-6 weeks depending on grip recovery.
items.why: Thumb dislocation/surgery recovery timeline per sources. ETR listed OUT.
items.implication: Bucs QB change multi-week; skill players affected.
items.opportunity: Backup QB environment for Evans/Godwin/Irving etc.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers, limited this week with hamstring and questionable, is expected to play today.
items.why: Source confirms; ETR expected, Levitan tinier dock no hard pitch count.

items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins (hamstring) return. DvP: Cowboys inflate opposing WR scoring +7.3% (most NFL); Texans implied 7th-most points.
items.why: ETR listed IN; elite matchup data + team total.
items.implication: Strong WR start/smash spot on return.
items.opportunity: High target share vs weak secondary in positive game script potential.

items.text: The moment Jordan Addison truthers have been waiting for. Home vs borderline NFL secondary with Justin Jefferson out.
items.why: JJ ruled out (ETR OUT list); home matchup soft.

items.text: Eagles situation getting worse. Without three of most important vs Rams: DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Zack Baun (later +Lane Johnson personal, Barkley hamstring).
items.why: Multiple key OUT + in-game losses; Levitan notes compounding.
items.implication: Eagles offense efficiency/volume down; Hurts/remaining skill capped.
items.opportunity: Reduced supporting cast for remaining players; Rams defensive upside.

items.text: Awesome to see Austin Ekeler out there again. He looks good! (Commanders context amid red-zone issues).
items.implication: Positive sign for any remaining Commanders RB involvement.
items.opportunity: Potential carry/target share if role holds.
